div.head: Hu 3.1
div.ab: Si tercio quis faciat, det decem solidos; ad quartam uicem perdat omne quod habet et sit utlaga (id est exul uel exlex), nisi rex ei patriam concedat.
Gyf he hit ðriddan siðe dó, sylle healf pund; æt ðam feorðan cyrre ðolie ealles ðæs ðe he age ⁊ beo útlah, buton him se cyng eard alyfe.
Quodsi tercio obtigerit, det dimidiam libram; si autem quarto, amittat omnia que possidet; ipse autem sit exlex, nisi rex patriam ei indulgeat.
Gyf hit ðriddan siðe dó, sylle healf pund; æt ðam feorðan cyrre ðolie ealles ðæs ðe he age ⁊ beo útlah, buton him se cyng eard alyfe.
If he does it a third time, he shall pay half a pound. On the fourth occasion he shall suffer the loss of all that he possesses and be outlawed, unless the king allow him to remain in the country.
Wenn er es zum dritten Male thut, zahle er ein halbes Pfund; beim vierten Male verliere er alles, was er hat, und werde geächtet, es sei denn, der König erlaubt ihm das Vaterland.
If he does it a third time, let him pay half a pound; the fourth time let him lose everything he has and be outlawed, unless the king permits him [to remain in] the homeland.
div.note: The Latin's ‘decem solidos’ = half a pound. Editors supply ‘he’ in B before ‘hit’.
